notes.title: Update 1.0i
notes.content:
⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES

 Greataxe skill is now doing damage based on unused capacity on given die => +1 damage per unused capacity.
 Decay skill is now inflicting Weak and Vulnerable based on unused capacity on given die => +1 Weak and +1 Vulnerable per 3 unused capacity.


✨ IMPROVEMENTS

 Modifiers selection is now persistent between runs.
 Descriptions of Feather, Thunderstorm and Chain Lightning updated to more reflect skills and relic effects.
 Whetstone description updated to reflect, that Whetstone does not work with ultimate skill.
 Jumping via Portal now shows quick teleport loading screen.


🛠️ FIXES

 Unstable Energy in upgraded version is fixed.
 Issue with possible Bratwurst abuse when visiting Merchant is fixed.
 Multiple bugs in all translations are fixed.
 Dialogues in Russian language are fixed.

notes.title: The Future of Luck & Loot: Roadmap Revealed!
notes.content:
Adventurers, we’ve been overwhelmed by the support so far, and we’re excited to share what’s next for Luck & Loot. Here’s a look at the journey ahead:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/b2c1374c6a9c2457ec742ab16cac604231805724.png"]


September 2025 — Fortune’s Favor
Feats, Fortunes, and Fatal Folly

Mac & Linux ports land this fall

Quality of Life updates + balancing tweaks

New gold-driven content: skills, relics, and more that reward you whether you’re rich or broke. Your fortune or misfortune can shape your path in Eldralith.

💡 Your fortune can fuel your fight… or your lack of it can twist fate in your favor.


[hr][/hr]

December 2025 — The Forgotten Fleet
Foes, Fog, and Fabulous Finds

A dangerous, pirate-themed dungeon

Packed with treasure and powerful relics

Haunted by the cursed crew of a crashed vessel with deadly foes guarding fabulous rewards

Includes a Bleed / Poison / Burn rework for sharper combat variety

⚓ The beach hides a fleet long forgotten… guarded by gold and ghosts alike.


[hr][/hr]

Future — Further Frontiers?
The future of Luck & Loot depends on how big this adventure grows. Every wishlist, every review, every share, and every new adventurer who joins helps shape what’s possible.

If you want to see even more content, new dungeons, and bigger updates, we need your help spreading the word. The bigger the community gets, the more we can build together.

What could be in store:

DLC content?

Mobile port?

Nintendo Switch and Game pad Support?

More community-driven features?


[hr][/hr]

Join the Adventure
Your feedback is shaping Luck & Loot every step of the way. The best place to share your ideas, find other adventurers, and help guide Eldralith’s future is our active Discord community. We’re always listening, and your thoughts directly influence what comes next.

👉 Join our Discord community!


[hr][/hr]

Help Us Grow
If you’re enjoying Luck & Loot, the best way to support development is to:

Share the game with your friends and communities

Tell your favorite content creators about it

Leave a review on Steam

Together, we can keep pushing Luck & Loot into new frontiers.

With much gratitude,
SMARTcreative

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0j

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0h
notes.content:

 New indicator for Dungeon cleared is displayed on the map.
 Skills, Relics and Enemies in Compendium are sorted in alphabetical order.


🛠️ FIXES

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0g
notes.content:

Multiplier can be viewed in hero selection by hovering over Maelor's Vial.  

Save notification is displayed every time game is saved.

notes.title: Luck & Loot Now in 13 Languages! Italian, Czech & Japanese!
notes.content:
🌍 Three New Languages Added to Luck & Loot!
Surprise, surprise! Luck & Loot now officially supports Italian, Czech, and Japanese, bringing our total to 13 languages and counting.


🗣️ New languages available:

Italiano (Italian)

Čeština (Czech)

日本語 (Japanese)

We’re committed to making Eldralith accessible to adventurers around the world, and this is just one more step in that direction. Whether you're swapping dice in Venice, Prague, or Tokyo, your loot, your fate, your story awaits.


🧩 Don’t forget to leave a review if you’ve been enjoying your runs. Every little bit helps support the game (and maybe wards off a curse or two).


💬 Join the party on Discord and let us know what language you'd like to see next!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0e & 1.0f
notes.content:
🛠️ FIXES


 Blood Link description is updated and no longer indicates "Heal" type.
 On-roll skills are now correctly return to the initial position.
 Rewind turn is no longer restarting use count on skills.
 Fixed issue with saving after buying out all items in Merchant event.
 Notification is no longer blocking skill from being dropped. 
 History is now correctly showing traits.
 Fixed a bug where modifiers were being shared between heroes with locked and unlocked Modifiers.

notes.title: New Languages + Big Thanks for Launch Weekend!
notes.content:
Luck & Loot now supports 3 more languages!


We’ve just added:
🇹🇷 Turkish
🇷🇺 Russian
🇵🇹 Portuguese

That brings us to a total of 10 supported languages, and we’re not done yet.
🧩 Czech and 🇮🇹 Italian are coming soon!

It’s been incredible to see so many of you diving into the dungeons, customizing your dice, and sharing your runs. Your support means the world to us.

💬 If you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a Steam review, it helps a ton, especially for a small team like ours. 

🙏 And to everyone who already has: thank you. Truly.


[hr][/hr]

💬 Talk to Us!


Join our Discord to share your feedback, ideas, or favorite moments! The dev team is active and listening in every language.

Let’s keep the loot rolling ⚔️🎲

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0c & 1.0d
notes.content:
🛠️ FIXES


 Screen resolution: issue with generating enemies out of dungeon for different screen resolutions is fixed.
 Compendium is now correctly synced with a Steam account.

 Visual fix for tutorial in main menu.

notes.title: Surprise! German Language Now Supported in Luck & Loot
notes.content:
We just launched Luck & Loot today with 6 languages… and we’re already adding a 7th!



German is now fully supported in-game, from UI to relics, combat tooltips to cursed events. If you're playing on Steam in German, the game should automatically switch. Otherwise, you can change it anytime in the in-game language settings.


🗨️ “Jetzt geht’s los!”
Yes, even Maelor the Lich knows what that means now.


Big shoutout to our localization team for making this happen on day one. We're actively working on more languages, so if yours isn’t in yet, hang tight — we're listening.

[hr][/hr]


💬 If you spot any issues or want to suggest edits, come chat with us in Discord, the dev team’s on full alert today.



💀 Viel Glück. Viel Loot.

— Team Luck & Loot

notes.title: ⚔️ The New Luck & Loot Demo is Here — Full Release on July 22!
notes.content:

Try the first 3 dungeons, play as our fearless warrior Tirnaya, and get a real taste of the full game before it drops on July 22.


We’ve rebuilt the demo from the ground up using the final launch content. This isn’t a preview, it’s your invitation to dive into Luck & Loot as it was meant to be played.



🎥 Watch the Gameplay Trailer

notes.title: Luck & Loot Launches July 22 – Forge Your Dice, Face the Darkness
notes.content:
🎲 Luck & Loot Launches July 22

Full Release – July 22, 2025 – 12:00 PM EST | 6:00 PM CEST

Step into the cursed kingdom of Eldralith in Luck & Loot, a tactical roguelike where dice don’t just decide your fate—they define it. After months of development and refinement, we're thrilled to announce the full release of Luck & Loot on PC.


▶️ Watch the Trailer

[previewyoutube=0ZSKIkspAjE;full][/previewyoutube]

💀 What Awaits You

Strategic dice-based combat meets dark fantasy storytelling in a world gripped by illusion, corruption, and impossible odds.

Build your dice. Choose your hero. Survive the loop.

Features at Full Launch:


 🎲 80+ Dice Faces — Craft your perfect build from interchangeable, upgradeable faces.

 🧙 3 Unique Heroes — Tirnaya, Isucor, and Ravenhardt each bring their own dice and despair.

 🐉 5 Procedurally Generated Dungeons — Each ruled by a devastating boss with distinct mechanics.

 📜 40+ Relics & 36+ Events — Discover secrets, curses, and rare synergies across your runs.

 🔥 16+ Difficulty Modifiers — Turn the dial up. But beware: power always comes at a price.

 ☠️ 40+ Enemy Types & Bosses — From fungal monstrosities to vampiric knights and whispering horrors.

👁 A World That Wants You to Lose

Luck & Loot is built to challenge. Expect to fall. To falter. To roll, curse, reroll—and try again.

Every death feeds the cycle. Every failure whispers truth. As an unknown interloper might say:

“You moved the pieces so carefully… How many times did he die for you?”


📜 Wishlist & Survive

This is a game for players who love to experiment, to lose with style, and to learn the rhythm of a world that doesn't want you to win. If that sounds like you:


👉 Wishlist now

👉 Challenge fate, July 22nd

notes.title: Luck & Loot - Limited Access Beta!
notes.content:
Heroes, scavengers, and wanderers of Eldralith—

The loop tightens. The gates of the Dark Keep draw near. And with it, a chance to help shape the future of Luck & Loot.

We’re kicking off our Closed Beta this week with a limited number of keys available.
To opt in, join our Discord and let us know that you're interested—we’ll add you to the private beta channel from there.

🎲 Join the Beta on Discord


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/5ce812f6eaf3f65d7aad5b3c73f45b807e2106d0.gif

🎨 VISUAL & AUDIO DESIGN


 New Color Palettes – You can now customize the look of your run. Whether you're feeling bleak, bold, or something in between, pick the palette that fits. (See gif above)

 Original Soundtrack Complete – The full soundtrack is now in-game, with haunting themes to match every ruin, ritual, and revelation.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/5a80b6a6951770ae7769aa32be4624e78ce30738.png
🧟‍♂️ ENEMIES & BOSSES

New threats have entered the cycle:


 Ghor'Mar, the two-headed giant in the Ruins—one head lives for battle, the other lives for fashion. They don’t always agree, but they both want you dead.

 Karnach, the Houndmaster, guards the Dark Keep with quiet fury—and a very real, very cursed beast.

 Maelor, the fallen king, awaits in the heart of the Keep. But to face him, you’ll need to prove you’re ready.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258162/98e21d265079f364d0df53aca6ec8cc9e14aa0df.png
🧩 GAMEPLAY & MECHANICS


 Ultimate Ability Tree – Each hero now has a unique upgrade path. Shape your style.

 Dungeon Traits – Dungeons now have distinct challenges: more floors, tougher enemies, better loot. Survive 3 of 4 to reach the Dark Keep.

 Difficulty Modifiers – After your first win, unlock new ways to challenge yourself and raise your score.

 Maelor's Vial – He only appears if you’ve stacked enough modifiers.

 New Skills & Dice Traits – Tons of new build options to explore. Try new synergies and break the cycle your way.


🏰 NARRATIVE & PROGRESSION

Fully Implemented Dialogue System – Win runs to reveal more about each hero. Their pasts, their regrets, their place in the cycle.

New Events –


 Duelist – fight for glory

 Coffin & Gallows – bargain with your soul

 Grinding Wheel, Goblifly, Bird Event, Wall of the Dead – sometimes survival pairs with strange encounters


📅 WHAT’S NEXT?

🧪 Closed Beta: Live This Week (Limited Keys)

 🗓️ Full Launch: June 2025

The world isn’t whole. The cycle hasn’t ended. But we’re getting close.

Sharpen your will. Take a breath. And when you're ready—

Roll the dice.
